title: Cristofano to the Signori of Siena, c. 1431-38 (ASSi Concistoro 2308, nos. 6 and 24), key R4755

documents.shelfmark: ASSi, Concistoro 2308, fasc. 2 "Lettere in cifra", no. 6 (DECODE R4795)

transcription.notes: Our transcription (siena1421, 24 Sept 2026, before any key) used for the verification; the solver's own transcription counts 1,007 elements. no06.tok has 1,056 tokens; the verification uses the 1,051 of no06_24all.tok lines 1-15 (same transcription, five struck or doubtful signs dropped).

documents.shelfmark: ASSi, Concistoro 2308, fasc. 2 "Lettere in cifra", no. 24 (DECODE R4812)
documents.date: not dated (c. 1431-38; 1437-38 fits the content best)

transcription.notes: Our transcription (siena1421, agents H and I for P2, agent E for the dorse); the solver counts 2,559 elements for P2 and did not cover the dorse.

system.summary: Key DECODE R4755: 36 cipher signs for 21 letters (four homophones each for a, e, i, o, u; one sign for each other letter), 7 nulls ('Nichil importantes'), 18 word signs of which 5 occur. No word division; clear salutation, then cipher.
system.notes: distinct_symbols = sign labels in our transcription of no. 6 (measured); the key itself has 36 letter signs, 7 nulls, 18 word signs.

conditions.human_role: George Lasry ran the solution with Claude and ChatGPT Astra (key recovered from the ciphertext, then the filed key R4755 found); this project verified it on its own blind transcription and decoded the dorse of no. 24

solution.what: siena1421: nos. 6 (1,051 signs) and 24 P2 (2,638) transcribed from the DECODE photographs with one sign legend; no. 24 dorse (637) first pass.

siena1421: homophonic anneal (homsolve2), null-aware (homsolve3) and bigram (sylsolve) solvers on nos. 6+24 under Italian, Latin, Catalan and Spanish models; no convergence (-2.9/token), although the solver breaks a synthetic cipher of the same size.
siena1421: fasc. 1 key alphabets compared by eye with the letters; R4755 indexed ('Cifra cum Christofano', Lucca, Piccinino) but not tried on nos. 6/24.
George Lasry, with Claude and the help of ChatGPT Astra: key recovered by cryptanalysis from the ciphertext only (homophonic, nulls, word signs), per his PDF.

George Lasry / ChatGPT Astra: the recovered key matched to the filed key sheet DECODE R4755, 'Cifra cum Christoforo Ghinucci[?]'; both letters deciphered with it (no. 6 and no. 24 P2), sent to Daniel Bourdeau on 14 Oct 2026.
DECODE photographs of R4755 (key), R4795 and R4812 fetched with the cookie; R4755 is the sheet shown in the PDF.

verify.py: our blind transcription decoded with the key read off the sheet by eye agrees with their letters at 69.1% (no. 6) and 69.4% (no. 24); with labels fitted by EM 79.8% / 76.2% one value per label, 90.5% / 88.2% allowing for labels our transcribers merged. Disagreements are our merged labels, not key values.
LM it-cinquecento order 5 per char: our decode -3.53/-3.62 (eye key) and -3.06/-3.34 (EM) against shuffled-key controls of mean -4.77/-4.77 and -4.03/-4.04 (20 runs each).

dorse24.py: the dorse of no. 24 (not in the submitted reading) decoded from our first-pass transcription; closing formula and signature 'Crist[ofa]no ... si racoman[d]a' found, so no. 24 is by the same writer as no. 6. LM -3.42 against a control of -3.96.
Dating checked: Mantua marquisate Sept 1433, Gonzaga to Milan 1438, Albert of Austria King of Hungary Dec 1437: no. 24 fits 1437-38 at least as well as the PDF's 1431-32.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 3689 tokens, 73 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.818 per letter; polyphonic: 23% of read tokens differ from their type's commonest value. Verdict: not applicable.

validation.notes: polyphonic: 23% of read tokens differ from their type's commonest value

outcome.method_basis: Per the solver's PDF the key was first recovered by cryptanalysis from the ciphertext alone and only afterwards matched to the filed key R4755, which then gave the readings; the ciphertext-only recovery is the first break, the match a confirmation.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_no06.txt + reading_no24.txt: decrypted letters outside <...>/{...} over all decrypted letters (879/941 + 1,663/2,286 = 2,542/3,227); the no. 24 dorse (637 tokens) is not counted

gaps.item: no. 24 P2, the <...> runs (623 of 2,286 decrypted letters)
no. 24 dorse P1 (637 tokens) beyond the closing formula and signature

credits.note: key recovered ciphertext-only with Claude and the help of ChatGPT Astra, then matched to DECODE R4755; readings of nos. 6 and 24
credits.source: PDF 'Siena, two ciphered letters to the Signori (Concistoro 2308, nos. 6 and 24)', sent to Daniel Bourdeau on 14 Oct 2026

outcome.notes: Result by George Lasry (with Claude and ChatGPT Astra), verified here. No. 6 93.4% of decrypted letters understood, no. 24 P2 72.7%; dorse of no. 24 decoded here in part. Verification by this project: blind transcription of 24 Sept decoded with the key, 69% (key read by eye) to 88-91% agreement.
